class WordCounter {

    // Constructor

        $this->words = [];
    }

    public function countWords($text) {
        $words = explode(' ', $text);
        foreach ($words as $word) {
            $word = strtolower($word);
            if (array_key_exists($word, $this->words)) {
                $this->words[$word]++;
            } else {
                $this->words[$word] = 1;
            }

        arsort($this->words);
